_about: The placement zones of the maps (src/core/world/zones.js and src/core/world/systems/place.js). A zone of a map (layers.zones) names its kind here (task). rule: pile (things lie in rows, one row for each size) or span (things go end to end across a gap, from the near end). accepts: the kind of item that fits. Units: half blocks (one map cell is 2) and seconds. pile: the named place of the map where the pile of the zone lies. lane: the column of cells in the zone where the items go (0 is the west column). rounds: the gap of each round (gap: its length; from: where it starts after the near end of the zone), the pile of the round (the size of each item), and the level of each skill. After a round the next one starts at the next dawn; after the last round, the rain of a later day breaks the span and a round opens again. skills: sum (the sum of the items against the gap) and groups (the same items, at least groupsMin of them). outcomes: how each end looks and sounds. exact: the span becomes solid (sound, give). long: the last item sticks out and wobbles (wobble: seconds), a person calls out (call: who and the key of the line), and then the item falls into the water and is lost. short: the last item tips when the hero steps on it, the hero falls into the water (fall: seconds in the water), and the friend pulls the hero out. The item floats back to the pile. hint: after this many failures in a round, the friend walks to the end of the items and looks at the gap for some seconds. watch: the person who watches the work by day while the zone is open, the place where the person stands, and when (the story flags: the elder first waits at the village hall, where the quest sends the child).
